items.question: Is blood donation in the UAE considered safe according to health authorities?
items.gold: Yes, donating blood is safe, because medical staff use the latest and best collection practices.
items.fact: UAE blood donation is safe, using latest collection practices

items.question: How often are blood donation drives held in the UAE?
items.gold: Several times throughout the year, at several locations.
items.fact: UAE blood donation drives held several times yearly at several locations
